OUR TIPS
========
EASY ADRESS SEARCH
Ein oder zwei Silben der Straße + Hausnummer genügen, z. B. „Kuni 72“ für „Kunigundenstraße 72, München“

ABBREVIATIONS
„MUC“ = Munich Airport, „Hbf“ = Munich Central Station (Hauptbahnhof), „OEZ“ = Olympia Shopping Centre (Olympiaeinkaufszentrum)

IN THE EVENT OF UNUSUAL RESULTS – RESET SETTINGS
"Gearwheel" at the top right >> "Reset settings" (at the very bottom)

WHERE IS STOP POSITION 4?
Tap on the stop name in the journey details/departures and load the plan of the stop. The number tells you from which point exactly your line departs.
Note: available for all underground stations and for stops with multiple stopping points.

SHOW FOOTPATH ON THE MAP
Simply tap on the footpath symbol to the stop or your destination in the journey details.

BUY A REQUIRED ADD-ON TICKET
Go to "Settings" - "My zones" and enter the tariff zones of your own weekly/monthly ticket.

UNDERSTAND A FEAUTIR
By tapping on the “?” in the bar on the top right, additional information on the optimal use of the app can be found.
